### DISCOVER A NATURAL WONDER IN THE HEART OF THE MENDIP HILLS

Cheddar Gorge is one of Britain’s most breathtaking natural landmarks - a dramatic limestone landscape carved by nature over millennia. Designated a Site of Special Scientific Interest and proudly part of the Mendip Hills National Landscape, it offers a rich blend of beauty, heritage, and adventure.

Marvel at towering cliffs, explore spectacular stalactite-filled caves, and uncover the secrets of our prehistoric past. As a world-renowned destination for caving and rock climbing, Cheddar Gorge is a haven for outdoor enthusiasts and curious minds alike.

Whether you're drawn by nature, wildlife, history, or adrenaline, Cheddar Gorge promises an unforgettable all-season day out in the heart of Somerset.

![A look out into the lush and vast landscape of cheddar gorge and caves and down into the winding roads below](https://media.umbraco.io/longleat-cheddar/dgrmn5ys/cheddar-gorge-and-caves-somerset-fantastic-day-out.jpeg?anchor=center&mode=crop&width=1920&height=1080&quality=80)

## Enjoy every moment

### Book in advance and save 10% on Day Tickets

You can buy discounted tickets up until midnight the day before you want to visit with prices from £23.30 for an adult and £17.50 for a child.

### Opening times

#### Our opening hours change with the seasons—just like the wildlife!

Our full opening times can be found [here](https://www.cheddargorge.co.uk/visit/opening-times).

### Parking

We recommend you arrive before 11.00 am especially during the school holidays and on bank holidays to ensure you find a space easily.

**Cheddar Gorge & Caves Car Parks**

**Locations:**

- Lakeside - 50 spaces

- Opposite Cox's Cave - 50 spaces

- Gough's Cave and upper gorge - 300 spaces


**Prices:**

- £7 per day

- £5 from 3pm-9pm

- Tickets are purchased from the designated parking meters. The funds raised via these parking costs contribute to the conservation of the gorge.


For more parking information, click [here](https://www.cheddargorge.co.uk/visit/how-to-find-us#further-parking-information).
